title: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within…
description: Anacrolix torrent versions before 1.63.0 have a vulnerability in the NewClient component where HTTPS tracker connections improperly skip certificate validation. This allows attackers who can intercept tracker traffic to impersonate trackers with any certificate, potentially exposing info_hash and peer_id values and returning forged peer lists.
